<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def read_state():
    rows=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    def cluster(ch, r0, r1):
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(64) if rows[r][c]==ch]
        if not pts: return None
        rs=[x[0] for x in pts]; cs=[x[1] for x in pts]
        return ((min(rs)+max(rs))//2,(min(cs)+max(cs))//2,len(pts))
    ring=cluster('p',15,28)
    ball=cluster('p',40,64)
    G=cluster('G',40,64)
    W=cluster('W',40,64)
    return {'ring':ring,'ball':ball,'G':G,'W':W}
print("before:", read_state())
r=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':30,'col':30}])
print("result:", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete','reward')})
print("after :", read_state())
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def read_state():
    rows=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    def cluster(ch, r0, r1):
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(64) if rows[r][c]==ch]
        if not pts: return None
        rs=[x[0] for x in pts]; cs=[x[1] for x in pts]
        return ((min(rs)+max(rs))//2,(min(cs)+max(cs))//2,len(pts))

    G=cluster('G',40,64)
    W=cluster('W',40,64)
    return {'ring':ring,'ball':ball,'G':G,'W':W}
